also: turn it off and on again

terms.comment: Traupman’s coinage on his initiāre, boot up (p. 260). A plain description also serves: Traupman and Andresian switch a computer or phone on with excitāre, to wake it (see switch on), so to restart it is dēnuō excitāre, to wake it again.

phrases.english: to wake (a phone or a computer) again: to restart it

sources: Lewis & Short: denuo · Lewis & Short: excito
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 260, 262, 369.
